IT & Cybersecurity.name: Google IT Support Certificate
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Online course for help desk work. No experience needed.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA A+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Covers hardware, operating systems and troubleshooting. The usual starting point for help desk and IT support jobs.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA Network+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Covers how networks are built, configured and fixed.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA Security+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Baseline security cert that many DoD and government contractor jobs ask for.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA Data+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Covers collecting, cleaning and reporting on data.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: Google Data Analytics Certificate
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Online course in spreadsheets, SQL and dashboards. No experience needed.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Introductory cert for working with Amazon's cloud platform.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Introductory cert for Microsoft's cloud platform.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: ITIL 4 Foundation
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Covers how IT departments run support and handle requests and outages.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA Linux+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For running and fixing Linux servers.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: Cisco CCNA
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Well known networking cert for configuring routers, switches and network security.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA CySA+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For security analyst roles that monitor networks and respond to threats.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CompTIA PenTest+
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For testing systems by trying to break into them, with permission.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Another penetration testing cert that DoD lists for some cyber jobs.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Hands-on security cert that goes deeper than Security+.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For investigating breaches and recovering evidence from computers.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For designing systems that run on Amazon's cloud.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: Esri Technical Certification
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For mapping and GIS work with ArcGIS, the software most GIS jobs use.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CISSP
IT & Cybersecurity.about: Senior security cert. Requires several years of paid security work experience.

IT & Cybersecurity.name: CISM
IT & Cybersecurity.about: For people who manage security programs rather than doing the hands-on work.

Project Management & Quality.name: Google Project Management Certificate
Project Management & Quality.about: Online course and certificate with no experience required.

Project Management & Quality.name: CAPM
Project Management & Quality.about: PMI's entry-level cert for people new to project management.

Project Management & Quality.name: Certified ScrumMaster
Project Management & Quality.about: For running teams that use Scrum, common in software companies.

Project Management & Quality.name: Six Sigma Yellow Belt
Project Management & Quality.about: Intro to Six Sigma for people who help on improvement projects.

Project Management & Quality.name: Certified Quality Technician (CQT)
Project Management & Quality.about: For inspection and testing work on a quality team.

Project Management & Quality.name: Six Sigma Green Belt
Project Management & Quality.about: Process improvement cert used a lot in manufacturing, logistics and healthcare.

Project Management & Quality.name: Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)
Project Management & Quality.about: For checking that a company follows its own standards and regulations.

Project Management & Quality.name: PMI-ACP
Project Management & Quality.about: PMI's cert for agile project management.

Project Management & Quality.name: PMP
Project Management & Quality.about: The most recognized project management cert. Requires experience leading projects, which military planning often counts toward.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: Certified Logistics Associate (CLA)
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: Entry-level cert covering warehouse safety, shipping and receiving.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: Certified Logistics Technician (CLT)
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: The step up from CLA, for inventory control and running warehouse operations.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: Commercial Driver's License (CDL)
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: Needed to drive trucks and buses. Veterans with military driving experience may be able to skip the skills test.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: Hazmat Endorsement
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: Added to a CDL so you can haul hazardous materials. Requires a TSA background check.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: Licensed Customs Broker
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: Federal license for clearing imports through customs. You have to pass the CBP exam.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: CPIM
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: Focused on inventory, planning and production.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: CSCP
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: Covers the full supply chain, from suppliers to customers.

Logistics & Supply Chain.name: CPSM
Logistics & Supply Chain.about: For purchasing and supply management roles.

Healthcare.name: BLS Provider
Healthcare.about: CPR and basic life support. Most patient-facing jobs require it.

Healthcare.name: EMT (NREMT)
Healthcare.about: National EMT certification. Army 68W medics already have to hold it.

Healthcare.name: Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT)
Healthcare.about: For working in pharmacies under a pharmacist.

Healthcare.name: Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT)
Healthcare.about: For drawing blood in hospitals, clinics and labs.

Healthcare.name: Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA)
Healthcare.about: For the hands-on side of medical assisting, like vitals, injections and prepping patients.

Healthcare.name: Certified EKG Technician (CET)
Healthcare.about: For running EKGs and heart monitoring.

Healthcare.name: Certified Dental Assistant (CDA)
Healthcare.about: National cert for dental assistants. Some states also have their own rules.

Healthcare.name: CRCST (Sterile Processing)
Healthcare.about: For cleaning, sterilizing and tracking surgical instruments.

Healthcare.name: Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
Healthcare.about: For turning medical records into billing codes. A lot of these jobs are remote.

Healthcare.name: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)
Healthcare.about: Each state runs its own CNA registry and exam. It's a common first step toward nursing.

Healthcare.name: Veterinary Technician National Exam (VTNE)
Healthcare.about: The exam most states require to work as a credentialed vet tech.

Healthcare.name: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA)
Healthcare.about: For clinical and office work in doctors' offices.

Healthcare.name: Certified Surgical Technologist (CST)
Healthcare.about: For working in the operating room alongside surgeons.

Healthcare.name: ARRT Certification
Healthcare.about: For X-ray, CT and MRI technologists. Most states require it to get licensed.

Healthcare.name: Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT)
Healthcare.about: For running tests on blood and tissue samples in a lab.

Healthcare.name: Certified Biomedical Equipment Technician (CBET)
Healthcare.about: For maintaining and repairing medical equipment.

Healthcare.name: ABO Optician Certification
Healthcare.about: For fitting and making glasses. Some states require it.

Healthcare.name: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)
Healthcare.about: For managing patient records. Requires an associate degree from an accredited program.

Healthcare.name: Licensed Practical Nurse (NCLEX-PN)
Healthcare.about: The exam you pass to get licensed as an LPN after a nursing program.

Healthcare.name: ACLS Provider
Healthcare.about: Advanced life support for cardiac emergencies. Required for a lot of hospital and paramedic jobs.

Healthcare.name: Paramedic (NRP)
Healthcare.about: The step up from EMT, with advanced life support skills.

Healthcare.name: Respiratory Therapist (CRT / RRT)
Healthcare.about: For treating patients with breathing problems. Needed for a state license.

Healthcare.name: Registered Nurse (NCLEX-RN)
Healthcare.about: The exam you pass to get licensed as an RN after a nursing degree.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: OSHA 10 / OSHA 30 Card
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Safety training card a lot of construction sites ask for. OSHA 30 is the longer version for supervisors.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: EPA Section 608
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Required by law to work on equipment with refrigerants, like air conditioning and HVAC.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: NCCER Credentials
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Industry credentials for construction trades like electrical, carpentry and pipefitting.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: Certified Production Technician (CPT)
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Entry-level manufacturing cert covering safety, quality and maintenance.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: NATE Certification
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: The best known cert for HVAC technicians.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: ASE Certification
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: The standard cert for auto and diesel mechanics.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: Certified Welder
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Shows you can weld to industry codes. Testing is done at accredited facilities.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: NIMS Machining Credentials
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Credentials for machinists and CNC operators.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: Certified Maintenance & Reliability Technician (CMRT)
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: For maintenance techs who keep industrial equipment running.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: ASNT NDT Certification
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: For inspecting parts and welds with methods like ultrasound and X-ray. Lines up well with military NDI work.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: Journeyman Electrician License
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Needed to work as an electrician in most states. Usually takes an apprenticeship and an exam.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: Journeyman Plumber License
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: Needed to work as a plumber in most states. Usually takes an apprenticeship and an exam.

Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.name: Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)
Skilled Trades & Manufacturing.about: For inspecting welds on job sites. Requires years of welding-related work.

Construction & Facilities.name: LEED Green Associate
Construction & Facilities.about: Covers green building basics. Common in construction and facilities jobs.

Construction & Facilities.name: Certified Associate Constructor (CAC)
Construction & Facilities.about: Entry-level construction management cert. The CPC is the next level up.

Construction & Facilities.name: ICC Certification
Construction & Facilities.about: For building, plumbing, electrical and fire code inspectors.

Construction & Facilities.name: Facility Management Professional (FMP)
Construction & Facilities.about: For running buildings and bases: maintenance, space, budgets and vendors.

Construction & Facilities.name: Certified Construction Manager (CCM)
Construction & Facilities.about: Senior construction management cert. Requires experience managing projects.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Associate Protection Professional (APP)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: For people early in a security management career.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Loss Prevention Qualified (LPQ)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: For retail and corporate loss prevention. The LPC is the advanced version.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Corrections Certification Program (CCP)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: National cert for corrections officers, on top of your state's training.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Police Officer Certification (POST)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: Every state's POST board certifies its police officers. Some states give credit for military police experience.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Security Guard License
Security & Law Enforcement.about: Most states require a license to work as a security guard, and an extra permit to carry a firearm.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Physical Security Professional (PSP)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: Covers security assessments and protecting facilities.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Professional Certified Investigator (PCI)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: For case management and investigations in the private sector.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE)
Security & Law Enforcement.about: For investigation work around fraud, common in corporate and government roles.

Security & Law Enforcement.name: Private Investigator License
Security & Law Enforcement.about: Most states license private investigators. Investigation experience often counts toward it.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: FEMA Incident Command Courses (IS-100, 200, 700, 800)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: Free online courses on how agencies coordinate during disasters. Most emergency jobs expect them.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Firefighter I and II
Fire, Emergency & Safety.issuer: Your state, accredited by IFSAC or Pro Board
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: The standard firefighter certs. Military firefighters often already hold them through the DoD program.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Wildland Firefighter (FFT2)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: Entry-level qualification for wildland fire crews. Includes a few short courses and a fitness test.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: HAZWOPER 40-Hour
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: Required training for hazardous waste and cleanup sites. Lines up well with CBRN experience.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Certified Fire Inspector I
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: For inspecting buildings for fire code problems.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Associate Safety Professional (ASP)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: For workplace safety jobs. The usual step before the CSP.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Associate Emergency Manager (AEM)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: For people getting into emergency management who don't have the experience for the CEM yet.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: For planning how a company keeps running after a disaster or outage.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: For managing hazardous materials programs and compliance.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: Senior safety cert. Requires a degree and years of safety work.

Fire, Emergency & Safety.name: Certified Emergency Manager (CEM)
Fire, Emergency & Safety.about: Senior emergency management cert. Military planning and disaster response experience can count.

Aviation.name: Remote Pilot Certificate (Part 107)
Aviation.about: Required to fly drones for work.

Aviation.name: Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Mechanic
Aviation.about: Needed to work on aircraft as a civilian mechanic. Military maintenance experience can count toward eligibility.

Aviation.name: Aircraft Dispatcher Certificate
Aviation.about: For planning flights and tracking them for an airline. Shares the dispatcher's legal responsibility with the captain.

Aviation.name: Commercial Pilot Certificate
Aviation.about: Required to be paid to fly. Military pilots can convert their flight experience.

Aviation.name: Airline Transport Pilot (ATP)
Aviation.about: Required to fly for an airline. Former military pilots can qualify with fewer flight hours.

Maritime.name: TWIC Card
Maritime.about: ID needed to get into secure areas of ports and ships without an escort.

Maritime.name: Merchant Mariner Credential (MMC)
Maritime.about: Needed to work on most U.S. commercial ships. Military sea service can count toward higher ratings.

Maritime.name: STCW Basic Training
Maritime.about: Safety training required to work on ships that sail internationally.

Maritime.name: ADCI Commercial Diver Card
Maritime.about: The card most U.S. diving contractors look for.

Energy & Utilities.name: GWO Basic Safety Training
Energy & Utilities.about: Safety training that most wind farms require before you can work on a turbine.

Energy & Utilities.name: NABCEP PV Associate
Energy & Utilities.about: Entry-level solar cert. No experience needed.

Energy & Utilities.name: Water and Wastewater Operator License
Energy & Utilities.about: Required to run water and wastewater treatment plants. Each state licenses its own operators.

Energy & Utilities.name: NABCEP PV Installation Professional
Energy & Utilities.about: For experienced solar installers and crew leads.

Energy & Utilities.name: NERC System Operator Certification
Energy & Utilities.about: Required to work in the control rooms that run the power grid.

Energy & Utilities.name: Certified Energy Manager (CEM)
Energy & Utilities.about: For cutting energy use in buildings and plants.

Energy & Utilities.name: NRC Reactor Operator License
Energy & Utilities.about: Required to run a commercial nuclear reactor. Plants sponsor you for it, and Navy nuclear experience is in demand.

Telecommunications.name: Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT)
Telecommunications.about: For installing, splicing and testing fiber optic cable.

Telecommunications.name: BICSI Installer and Technician
Telecommunications.about: For installing network cabling in buildings.

Telecommunications.name: ETA Certifications
Telecommunications.about: Electronics and communications certs, including ones for radio and tower work.

Telecommunications.name: FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License
Telecommunications.about: Often required for avionics and radio repair work.

Telecommunications.name: Certified Wireless Network Administrator (CWNA)
Telecommunications.about: For setting up and troubleshooting Wi-Fi networks.

Telecommunications.name: Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD)
Telecommunications.about: For designing the cabling and communications systems in buildings.

Business & Professional Services.name: Microsoft Office Specialist (MOS)
Business & Professional Services.about: Shows you know Word, Excel and Outlook well. Useful for office and admin jobs.

Business & Professional Services.name: aPHR
Business & Professional Services.about: Entry-level HR cert with no experience required.

Business & Professional Services.name: Certified Administrative Professional (CAP)
Business & Professional Services.about: For administrative assistants and office managers.

Business & Professional Services.name: Certified Paralegal (CP)
Business & Professional Services.about: National paralegal cert. Military paralegal work lines up well.

Business & Professional Services.name: ATA Certification
Business & Professional Services.about: For translators, tested one language pair at a time.

Business & Professional Services.name: SHRM-CP
Business & Professional Services.about: Common HR cert for people doing day-to-day HR work.

Business & Professional Services.name: PHR
Business & Professional Services.about: HR cert focused on running HR programs and following employment law.

Business & Professional Services.name: APTD
Business & Professional Services.about: For trainers and people who build training courses. Military instructor experience counts.

Business & Professional Services.name: Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM)
Business & Professional Services.about: For buying and managing government contracts.

Business & Professional Services.name: CPTD
Business & Professional Services.about: Senior cert for people who run training programs.

Business & Professional Services.name: SHRM-SCP
Business & Professional Services.about: For senior HR leaders who set policy and strategy.

Finance & Accounting.name: QuickBooks Certified User
Finance & Accounting.about: Shows you can keep a small business's books in QuickBooks.

Finance & Accounting.name: Certified Bookkeeper
Finance & Accounting.about: For bookkeepers who handle payroll, reconciliations and closing the books.

Finance & Accounting.name: Enrolled Agent (EA)
Finance & Accounting.about: Lets you prepare taxes and represent people in front of the IRS.

Finance & Accounting.name: Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM)
Finance & Accounting.about: For defense budget and finance work, including at contractors and DoD civilian jobs.

Finance & Accounting.name: Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM)
Finance & Accounting.about: For finance and accounting work in federal, state and local government.

Finance & Accounting.name: Certified Management Accountant (CMA)
Finance & Accounting.about: For budgeting, cost analysis and financial planning inside a company.

Finance & Accounting.name: Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
Finance & Accounting.about: The main license for accountants. Most states require 150 college credit hours.

Food Service.name: ServSafe Food Handler
Food Service.about: Basic food safety. Some states require it for anyone handling food.

Food Service.name: ServSafe Manager
Food Service.about: Food safety cert for managers. Many states require one on every shift.

Food Service.name: Certified Culinarian (CC)
Food Service.about: Entry cert for professional cooks. There are higher levels for chefs.

Fitness & Coaching.name: NASM Certified Personal Trainer
Fitness & Coaching.about: One of the most common personal trainer certs gyms ask for.

Fitness & Coaching.name: ACE Certified Personal Trainer
Fitness & Coaching.about: Another widely accepted personal trainer cert.

Fitness & Coaching.name: Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS)
Fitness & Coaching.about: For training athletes and tactical teams. Requires a bachelor's degree.
